entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold while we connect you to the next available agent.
Oh, okay... I hope someone can help. This is just so disappointing.
Hi, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Hello, David. I... I need to make a return. I'm just so sad about it. I saved up for this.
I'm sorry to hear you're disappointed. I can certainly look into that for you. Do you have your order number handy?
Yes, it's VF886-09B. It's for that new Pro-Cycle jersey. I've been a loyal customer for years, and I was so excited, but it's just not right.
Okay, I have your order pulled up. I see the jersey was delivered about 55 days ago. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with it?
It's the wrong size. I ordered my usual medium, but it's just way too tight across the chest. I feel terrible having to send it back, I really needed this money if it wasn't going to work out.
I understand. Is it a technical fault with the jersey, or more of a sizing preference?
It's just the sizing. I was hoping I could exchange it, but I'm worried I waited too long. It's just been sitting in the bag, I've been so busy.
Not to worry at all. Let me just confirm our policy for you... one moment. Okay, I've checked, and for a standard item like this jersey, you're unfortunately outside our 10-day return window.
Wait, really? I thought I was way too late. Are you sure?

Yes, absolutely. Since it's a standard apparel item and it was delivered 55 days ago, you're clear. We can definitely process an exchange for a different size or issue a full refund, whichever you prefer.
Oh, thank you! That's such a relief! I would love to exchange it for a Large. I was so worried. Thank you, David.

You're very welcome. I've just initiated the exchange for a size Large. I'm sending a prepaid return label to your email now. Just pack up the original jersey and drop it off at any post office, and we'll ship the new one as soon as we see the return has been scanned. Is there anything else I can help with?
No, that's perfect. You've been a great help. Thank you so much!
Happy to assist. Thanks for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
